accounts.parentAccountHint: Optional — creates this record as a nested sub-account directly under the account you choose, using its code.

invoices.bookedNeedsDate: A booked line needs a delivery date

recurringInvoices.name: Name
recurringInvoices.subtitle: Templates that auto-generate draft invoices on a schedule
recurringInvoices.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this recurring template? It will stop generating new invoices.

items.inventoryAccountHint: The asset account this item's stock value is tracked against.
items.quantityDeltaHint: Positive to receive stock (e.g. 5), negative to remove stock (e.g. -2).
items.unitCostOptional: Unit Cost (for positive adjustments, optional — defaults to current avg. cost)
items.pickItemHint: Optionally link this line to a stock item
items.adjustBranchHint: Which location's balance this adjustment applies to. Leave as unbranched pool for companies not using branches.
items.variantAttributesHint: Names of the attributes that define this item's variants (e.g. Color, Size). Leave empty if this item has no variants.
items.variantsOpeningHint: Opening stock is set per variant — add variants below after saving.
items.noAttributesHint: This item has no variant attributes defined yet. Edit the item to add attribute names (e.g. Color, Size) before adding variants.
items.adjustVariantHint: Optionally scope this adjustment to one specific variant instead of the item as a whole.
items.addCategoryHint: Create a category here, then pick it from the Category dropdown above.
items.addUnitHint: Create a plain unit here, then pick it above. To define a conversion (e.g. 1 Roll = 50 Meter), edit it from the Units page.
items.imageHint: Save the item first, then upload an optional photo for it.

units.pageHint: Define units of measure once and reuse them across items. Give a unit a base unit + conversion factor to record what it actually represents — e.g. 1 Roll = 50 Meter, 1 Box = 12 Piece.
units.noneIsBaseUnit: None — this is a base unit
units.baseUnitHint: Leave as None if this unit stands on its own (e.g. Piece, Meter, Kilogram). Pick a base unit to define a conversion (e.g. this unit is "Roll", base is "Meter").

financialSettings.costCenterDefault: Default Parent Account for New Cost Centers

bookings.pageHint: Items sold but not yet delivered — the client wants them on a specific later date, so the stock stays fully counted in inventory (see the Booked/Available columns on the Items page) until you mark it delivered here.
